text: After extracting the entries, two researchers cross-compared the materials. The specific steps of the KJ process were: coding, selecting representative statements from the interview data and condensing them into concise entries; transferring the coded quotes to small cards; and theme extraction. All members read the cards five times to determine which were related to the theme. After understanding each card, they grouped cards with similar contents, summarized them, and added an ?A title.? The titled groups were treated as a whole and regrouped with related small cards; the process was repeated to form B, C, and D title groups and ultimately six major themes. For the six identified themes, physical cards were iteratively rearranged on a background sheet until their spatial arrangement reflected logical relationships. Symbols were used to annotate connections among themes.
